title: Human Islet Microvasculature Immunofluorescence in Optically Cleared Samples
author: Martha Campbell-Thompson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y3tfynn
materials: Incubate the samples with primary antibodies on a rocker plate for 48:00:00 1-5 days at Room temperature .
Dilute the secondary antibodies to 1:500 and prepare at least 1 mL per sample. Incubate for 48:00:00 or more on a rocker at Room temperature .

Make antibody dilution buffer (ABD): 1x PBS containing 2% normal goat serum (NGS) and 0.5% Triton-X 100. PBS Phosphate Buffered Saline 10X Solution Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP399-1 Goat normal serum Vector Laboratories Catalog #S-1000 Triton X-100 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #T8787-100
Dilute the primary antibodies to 1:200 in ABD and prepare at least 1 mL per sample.

steps.title: PBS Wash Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue sections with 1× PBS (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP399-1) five times, for a minimum total of 1 hour at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 1× PBS to the sections.
Incubate briefly, then discard.
Repeat the wash five times, ensuring the cumulative wash time is at least 01:00:00.
Keep the samples at room temperature throughout.

steps.title: Optical Clearing with SDS
steps.instruction: Clear the samples using 4 % SDS at 60 °C with gentle rocking until they become transparent (up to 3 weeks).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 4 % SDS solution (or 8 % SDS as an alternative) in appropriate buffer.
Place samples in the SDS solution.
Incubate at 60 °C with continuous rocking.
Monitor transparency; continue up to 3 weeks until samples are clear.

steps.title: Post‑Clearing PBS Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the cleared tissue with 1× PBS five times, for at least 1 hour total at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 1× PBS to each cleared sample.
Incubate briefly, discard the wash.
Repeat the wash five times, ensuring a cumulative duration of ≥01:00:00.
Maintain samples at room temperature.

steps.title: RIMS Equilibration and Mounting
steps.instruction: Equilibrate samples in RIMS containing 0.5 % sodium azide for ≥12 hours, then mount in RIMS on an imaging dish or chamber slide.

substeps.instruction: Prepare RIMS solution with 0.5 % sodium azide.
Submerge samples in RIMS and incubate for at least 12:00:00 at room temperature.
Transfer each sample to an imaging dish or chamber slide using RIMS as the mounting medium.

steps.title: Configure Confocal Laser Settings
steps.instruction: Set up the Zeiss LSM 710 confocal microscope with the required laser lines and optimize imaging parameters.

substeps.instruction: Select laser line 488 nm for Collagen IV detection.
Select laser line 405 nm for GCG detection.
Select laser line 561 nm for SMA detection.
Adjust detector gain, pinhole size, and other parameters for optimal signal‑to‑noise.

steps.title: Acquire Confocal Images
steps.instruction: Perform confocal microscopy on the mounted samples using the LSM 710, capturing each antigen with its designated laser track.

substeps.instruction: Load the sample into the microscope stage.
Acquire images for Track 1 (488 nm – Collagen IV).
Acquire images for Track 2 (405 nm – GCG and 561 nm – SMA).
Save datasets with appropriate metadata.

steps.title: Quantify Microvascular Density
steps.instruction: Analyze islet microvascular density by contouring GCG⁺ areas for islet volume and performing collagen IV and SMA morphometry with Vesselucida360.

substeps.instruction: Import image stacks into Vesselucida360.
Contour the GCG⁺ region to calculate islet volume.
Perform morphometric analysis of collagen IV‑positive basement membranes.
Perform morphometric analysis of SMA‑positive smooth‑muscle cells surrounding vessels.
Export quantitative results.
